title: A status change records who made it and when
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active part, part A, for this test.
  • Write down the date and time on your computer clock just before step 1.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
custom_steps:
1. Click the part A row.
  2. Click Inactive under Part Status.
  3. Click Save.
  4. Click Deactivate in the confirmation.
  5. Click the Inactive tab.
  6. Click the clock icon (Part History) at the left of the part A row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens.

Step 2:

  • Inactive is picked.

Step 3:

  • The "Deactivate part?" confirmation opens; leave the note empty.

Step 4:

  • "Part deactivated." shows and part A leaves the Active tab.

Step 5:

  • Part A is listed on the Inactive tab.

Step 6:

  • The newest Part History entry reads "Deactivated", with your name under Staff, today's date under Date, and under Time the time you wrote down or a minute or two later.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change)

  • S10-R14: “Every status change records the user who made it, and the date and time.”
  • S10-R17: “The entry reads "Deactivated" or "Activated". When the user gave a note it reads "Deactivated | Reason: {note}" or "Activated | Reason: {note}". With no note it reads "Deactivated" or "Activated" and nothing more.”
